subject: Invoice creation + billing contact activation — email vs portal decision
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Leslie Armstrong <leslie.armstrong@acme.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Invoice creation + billing contact activation — email vs portal decision

Hi Leslie,

Thanks again for the conversation yesterday — excited to get Acme set up on Redwood. Before we flip the switch on first invoices for your POC usage, a couple quick asks so AP can receive invoices in the format that works best for you: 

- Do you want us to push invoices into Acme's portal via SFTP/API (preferred for automated reconciliation) or keep delivering PDF/XML copies by email to ap@acme.com?
- If portal/API, please confirm the hostname and a technical contact for credentials; if email, confirm the billing contact name + address and whether you need a separate VAT tag per entity.

I've attached our standard invoice template (redwood_invoice_template.pdf) and a sample e-invoice XML (sample_einvoice.xml) for Acme's schema team to review.

If helpful, we can do a 20-minute handoff with your AP/tech team tomorrow to walk through the sample payloads.

Next steps I propose: you confirm preferred channel + billing contact by EOD Monday; we will queue the first invoice for Nov 30 and send a test file to your team.

Best,
Naomi
Head of Billing Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_invoice_template.pdf (invoice PDF template), sample_einvoice.xml (XML schema sample)

From: Leslie Armstrong <leslie.armstrong@acme.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Nov 2025 08:07:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Invoice creation + billing contact activation — email vs portal decision

Hi Naomi,

Thanks — quick answers from AP below: 

1) Preference: portal/API push preferred. We can consume XML via SFTP drop (overnight) or HTTPS webhook. Our default is SFTP to avoid firewall work, but we can do HTTPS if you require real-time.

2) Billing contact: please send a copy to ap@acme.com and also cc my colleague, Tara Singh (tara.singh@acme.com) for the first three invoices while we validate VAT mapping.

3) VAT: Acme needs a VAT tag on each invoice line and a separate document-level VAT summary for EU entities.

We can do the 20-minute handoff — Tara and I are available Mon 11/24 10:00–11:00 PT. Please send SFTP details or webhook spec.

Thanks,
Leslie Armstrong
Director, Finance Ops — Acme Corp

- Kimberly: can you provision a test SFTP endpoint + sample drop instructions by EOD today? If SFTP isn't practical, please note HTTPS webhook as backup.
- Ben: please update the mutual action plan (HubSpot link below) with the onboarding milestone and confirm Nov 30 invoice scheduling only after we complete the test drop.

Thanks — I’ll create the calendar invite for 10:00 PT and include the call dial-in.

—Naomi

- SFTP test endpoint created: sftp://sftp-test.acme-payments.com/redwood-test (credentials delivered in separate secure channel).
- XML payload validated for line-level VAT tags; we adjusted the sample to include 'vatRate' and a 'euSummary' node. See attached sample_einvoice.xml (updated).
- Naomi / Ben: we will schedule the first test drop for Tue 11/25 02:00 PT (overnight). If that passes, we will tag the Nov 30 invoice as "production" and deliver to acme's SFTP target.

Tara — we will CC you on the first three test and production drops per request. If you need the invoice PDF in addition to XML for internal sign-off, we can include a PDF bundle.

Next steps:
- Acme confirms receipt of test SFTP drop by Tue 11/25 12:00 PT.
- Naomi confirms production go/no-go after test pass.
